name: SMART-LLM Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset for validating multi-robot task planning problems, covering four categories of high-level instructions with varying task complexity. It supports evaluation of LLM-based frameworks that convert high-level instructions into multi-robot task plans.
reputation: A recent benchmark from the robotics planning literature that is useful for evaluating LLM-based multi-robot task planning, but it is not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Benchmark includes four categories of high-level instructions; evaluation spans simulation and real-world scenarios.
